scope: R3 evm:shanghai opcode eligibility checked by real read-only PUSH0 execution on each endpoint. Other VM/precompile, account, fork and transaction probes remain open.

contract.operation: Contract-creation eth_call at latest, bytecode 0x5f60005260206000f3, gas 0x186a0; exact zero word confirms PUSH0 execution. No transaction is submitted.
contract.targets: Every recorded endpoint through its configured RPC authentication; five-second per-node bound. Identity and consensus gates run first and their observations remain separate.
contract.classification: Actual PUSH0 invalid-opcode execution error yields unsupported/SKIP. Missing probe API, invalid request parameters, unrelated execution failures, unusable result or HTTP failure yield unknown/BLOCKED. Unknown outranks unsupported. Unexpected runtime skips still FAIL.
contract.provenance: vm-capability-probes.json stores capability, method, bounded bytecode and per-node role/status/source/reason. Raw transport messages and credentials are omitted.

limitations: This confirms the PUSH0 opcode represented by the existing evm:shanghai gate, not every Shanghai EIP or gas rule.
Protocol/transport/unusable-response boundaries use unit fixtures; native gateways only forward genuine chain bytes.
No browser source changed; browser was not rerun separately.
Initial full check rejected a constant comment naming another symbol; comment was corrected and final full check/race passed.
R3 other probes, P4 adequacy, R4/R5 remainders, R6/full Linux HEAD L1, tasks 10–14 and frozen Web14 acceptance remain pending.
